name: vcglib
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: vcglib
  version: "2025.07"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/cnr-isti-vclab/vcglib/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: e49fc9342d5476b3e39a5e1939b965b57c91d7a17b4f97b8c5eaf01228b16cf0
  patches:
    # use conda-forge's openfbx (0.9 API) instead of the copy in wrap/openfbx
    - use-conda-forge-openfbx.patch

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  # one variant per OS family: headers go to $PREFIX/include on unix and to
  # %PREFIX%\Library\include on Windows (noarch_platforms in conda-forge.yml)
  script:
    # Header-only. Bundled third-party code that conda-forge packages is not
    # installed: Eigen (eigenlib/; its only user, vcg/math/eigen.h, is Eigen-2
    # era code that does not compile with Eigen 3+) and OpenFBX incl. miniz
    # (wrap/openfbx; wrap/io_trimesh/import_fbx.h is patched to use openfbx).
    # NEWUOA (wrap/newuoa) and Tsai (wrap/tsai) have no conda-forge package
    # with this API; they stay, with their licenses packaged.
    - if: unix
      then:
        - mkdir -p $PREFIX/include/vcglib
        - cp -R vcg wrap img $PREFIX/include/vcglib/
        - rm -r $PREFIX/include/vcglib/wrap/openfbx
      else:
        - xcopy /E /I /Q vcg %LIBRARY_INC%\vcglib\vcg
        - xcopy /E /I /Q wrap %LIBRARY_INC%\vcglib\wrap
        - xcopy /E /I /Q img %LIBRARY_INC%\vcglib\img
        - rmdir /S /Q %LIBRARY_INC%\vcglib\wrap\openfbx

requirements:
  run:
    - if: unix
      then: __unix
      else: __win
    - eigen
    # for wrap/io_trimesh/import_fbx.h
    - openfbx

tests:
  - package_contents:
      files:
        exists:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - include/vcglib/vcg/complex/complex.h
              - include/vcglib/wrap/io_trimesh/import_ply.h
              - include/vcglib/wrap/io_trimesh/import_fbx.h
            else:
              - Library/include/vcglib/vcg/complex/complex.h
              - Library/include/vcglib/wrap/io_trimesh/import_ply.h
              - Library/include/vcglib/wrap/io_trimesh/import_fbx.h
        not_exists:
          - "**/vcglib/wrap/openfbx/**"
          - "**/vcglib/eigenlib/**"
  - script:
      - if: unix
        then: ${CXX} -std=c++17 -fsyntax-only -I$PREFIX/include/vcglib -I$PREFIX/include/eigen3 -I$PREFIX/include test.cpp
        else: cl /nologo /std:c++17 /EHsc /Zs /I%LIBRARY_INC%\vcglib /I%LIBRARY_INC%\eigen3 /I%LIBRARY_INC% test.cpp
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    files:
      recipe:
        - test.cpp

about:
  homepage: https://vcg.isti.cnr.it/vcglib/
  repository: https://github.com/cnr-isti-vclab/vcglib
  summary: The VCG Library, a C++ template library for triangle and tetrahedral meshes
  description: |
    Header-only C++ library for the manipulation, processing, cleaning and
    simplification of triangle meshes (used by MeshLab and OpenMVS). Headers
    are installed under include/vcglib and use conda-forge's eigen and
    openfbx.
  # VCG: GPL-3.0 text, files GPL-2.0-or-later; wrap/tsai: GPL-2.0-or-later;
  # wrap/newuoa: MIT; wrap/nanoply: MPL-2.0 (license notices are in those headers)
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later AND GPL-2.0-or-later AND MIT AND MPL-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE.txt
    - wrap/newuoa/include/newuoa.h
    - wrap/tsai/tsaimethods.h
    - wrap/nanoply/include/nanoply.hpp

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Tobias-Fischer
